submit_mode.description: If non-empty, after a successful render, also commit ('submit') or shelve ('shelve') the task's outputs into the worker's Perforce client. '' (default) is a no-op so adding this field is safe.

project_name.description: Unreal project name. Used by the optional Perforce submit hook to resolve the persistent workspace (workspace name is <user>_<host>_<project_name>[_<worker_id>]). Pass the same value the submitter put on the render job's ProjectName parameter.

project_relative_path.description: Path to the .uproject from the workspace root, e.g. 'MyProject/MyProject.uproject'. Used by the Perforce submit hook to compute where renders should be staged inside the workspace (P4_CLIENT_DIRECTORY/<project_dir>/Saved/MovieRenders) before commit. Pass the same value the submitter put on the render job's ProjectRelativePath parameter.
